checks.name: Shared navigation
actions: Follow Resources, Contact, Session guide and Home on each site
checks.expected: Every navigation link resolves to its intended scoped page.
checks.actualSource: Fresh retest: All four destinations opened; guide route is /guide/.
checks.actualTarget: Fresh retest: All four destinations opened; guide route is /help/.

checks.name: Required checklist from both referring pages
actions: Follow checklist from home on source and target
Repeat from resources
Read the resulting content/error and compare the source checklist bytes
checks.expected: Both target entry points open the approved checklist.
checks.actualSource: Both entry points open the correct four-line checklist; response bytes match the approved fixture.
checks.actualTarget: Both entry points now open the same correct checklist at both sizes; HTTP 200 and exact file bytes confirmed.

checks.name: Both guide disclosures with mouse and keyboard
actions: Tab from last navigation link to the first summary
Press Enter then Space on each summary
Click both summaries open, inspect answers, then close both
checks.expected: Each native disclosure opens/closes and retains its answer using pointer and keyboard.
checks.actualSource: Fresh retest: Both answers retained; recorded closed/open state sequences succeeded.
checks.actualTarget: Fresh retest: Same answers and state sequences succeeded at mapped /help/.

checks.actualSource: Fresh retest: Resources > Contact > Session guide > first summary; visible red focus outline.
